description: A test suite for DurableGrain functionality in Orleans, focusing on state persistence, complex types, multiple collections, modifications, and large state handling using Xunit framework.

classes.name: DurableGrainTests
classes.description: Test class for verifying the durability and functionality of Orleans grains with journaling, using Xunit framework.

methods.name: DurableGrain_State_Persistence_Test
methods.description: Tests basic persistence and recovery of state across grain deactivation.

methods.name: DurableGrain_Update_State_Test
methods.description: Verifies that state updates are properly journaled and persisted.

methods.name: DurableGrain_Complex_Types_Test
methods.description: Checks serialization and persistence of complex nested objects and collections.

methods.name: DurableGrain_Multiple_Collections_Test
methods.description: Asserts that multiple durable collections can coexist and maintain state independently.

methods.name: DurableGrain_State_Modifications_Test
methods.description: Ensures modifications like add, update, remove are properly journaled and recovered.

methods.name: Grain_State_Should_Persist_Between_Activations
methods.description: Verifies state persistence with a different grain interface across deactivations.

methods.name: Grain_Should_Handle_Multiple_Collections
methods.description: Tests collection operations and persistence with multiple deactivation cycles.

methods.name: Grain_Should_Handle_Large_State
methods.description: Stress test for large state data, ensuring journaling handles high volume without performance issues.
